summary: Frontend-only test of /instruments with tonejs-instruments sampled playback. All 4 sampled instruments (piano, guitar, bass, violin) reach 'Samples loaded' state (~1s each after first piano load). Drum Pad tab shows loaded immediately. Piano key clicks, guitar strings, bass notes, violin notes, drum pads, and keyboard shortcut 'a' produce zero console/page errors. window.AudioContext present; CDN sample https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/nbrosowsky/tonejs-instruments@master/samples/violin/A4.mp3 fetch returned 200 OK. Regression: /, /shop, /apps/groovsesh load with no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: sampler.js: loadBuffer .catch returns null but never removes from buffers; retry works via pending cleanup — OK.
audioEngine.ensureCtx: resume() is fire-and-forget; acceptable for gesture-triggered playback.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 9: /instruments sampled playback verified end-to-end. All tabs load samples, no console errors, CDN reachable from browser context. Regression pages OK.
